title: 2D Rotary Position Embeddings for Vision: Complete Math and Implementation
description: Complete derivation of Rotary Position Embeddings from complex number rotation through 1D RoPE to 2D vision — why relative position matters, how frequency bands encode spatial scale, and full PyTorch implementation with shape traces.
venue: Based on Su et al., RoFormer (2021) arXiv:2104.09864
